title: T-SQL errors: read the messages, fix conversion, divide-by-zero and MERGE faults
objective_text: Read each T-SQL error message, say what caused it, and choose the change that fixes it.
scenario: A warehouse load fails in three places: a text quantity, a zero divisor and a MERGE. The on-call engineer has the messages and needs to pick the right fix for each.
verifies: You can pick the right feature, setting or operator for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can do it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
review_notes: Every claim was checked against its source page on 2026-11-07.

Sources read 2026-11-07: tsql-surface-area (MERGE generally available), merge-transact-sql (applies to Warehouse in Microsoft Fabric; can't update the same row more than once; Fabric syntax needs the semicolon, error 10713; no TOP), try-cast and nullif (both apply to Warehouse in Microsoft Fabric), errors 245 and 8134 from the Database Engine error lists. MERGE's own error number isn't quoted because the page read doesn't show it.
